grounding_mechanism: BM25 top-K retrieval → numbered [doc N] context block → Gemini answer constrained to retrieved evidence with mandatory [doc N] citations; returns grounded=false gracefully when Vertex unavailable
vertex_dependency: gemini-2.5-flash via vertexai SDK; grounded=false fallback when unavailable
note: BM25 chosen over Vertex AI Search because corpus is 497 rows — managed index adds no retrieval quality benefit at this scale while adding operational overhead.

vertex_genai_eval.interpretation: grounded_response_rate_substantive=91.7%: of 12 queries where Gemini produced a substantive answer, 11 were verified fully attributable to retrieved context. 8/20 queries triggered a correct refusal (hallucination prevention) on out-of-corpus queries (septic shock, acute MI, neutropenic fever, pediatric). 1/20 partial hallucination detected (Q-002).
